interpretation: Contract red executes two failures; green executes three passes. Five focused regressions pass, including the real native Unicode/login/Resume workflow. Harness rebuild passes the status/handoff method again.

Delayed editable-row and empty-sibling scripted workflows pass after one compiler-only test diagnostic error was fixed. They do not reproduce or resolve the first actual GUI-Owl click rejection. The empty-sibling variant includes an initial no-effect observation and is not an identical first-frame replay.
Ten distinct methods have successful checkpoints here; four newly passing methods raise the conservative historical minimum to 315 Mac and 10 iOS. This is not a current full-suite pass.

GUI-Owl sends six proposals and executes three exact typing actions in Origin after rejected clicks. Destination stays empty and Origin becomes TokyoTokyoTokyo. A proposed close also violates the instruction to leave the form open; the close is not dispatched. The task fails at its six-proposal bound.
GUI-Owl peak 3392421888 bytes remains below the unchanged 4294967296-byte cap. All six workers exit and remove their temporary credentials.

Holo returns no proposal and sends zero input. The supervisor records memory-limit at 4312137728 bytes; the independently sampled peak is 4312367104. Its worker exits and removes its credential. The Swift diagnostic runner surfaces invalidResponse; the worker report is the cause evidence.

Both alternatives use the same fixed form, goal, full-display image policy and 4 GiB cap as the preceding Fara Q4 native trial. Their probes launch a fresh worker per proposal, whereas Fara retains its worker across proposals. This limits residency/performance comparison.
No source admission changes were made from the GUI-Owl click failure, and no model is promoted. Fara remains eligible and selected; the native executor remains a candidate outside production routing.
remaining: Capture the exact first-click target identity and changed pixel bounds without another full model retry.
General recovery must not treat a rejected focus action as a successful prerequisite for typing; model and app behavior must be distinguished.
Verify goal constraints, including preserving unrelated fields and leaving documents/windows open, across the fixed cross-domain set.
Remaining generic native actions, clarification, production routing, provider login, phone integration and whole-app 12 GB/thermal acceptance remain open.
